create.name: Dzigar Kongtrul Rinpoche
create.bio:
Dzigar Kongtrul Rinpoche is a teacher of the Longchen Nyingtik tradition of Tibetan Buddhism's Nyingma school. He was born in northern India into a family of practitioners: his father was an incarnation of the treasure-revealer Chogyur Lingpa, and his mother, who had spent many years in retreat, was his first teacher. When he was nine, Dilgo Khyentse Rinpoche and the sixteenth Karmapa recognised him as a rebirth of the great nineteenth-century master Jamgon Kongtrul. He grew up in monasteries and trained above all with Dilgo Khyentse Rinpoche, as well as with Tulku Urgyen Rinpoche, Nyoshul Khen Rinpoche and Khenpo Rinchen.

He settled in the United States in 1989 and taught Buddhist philosophy at Naropa University for five years, during which he founded Mangala Shri Bhuti to root his lineage in the West. The organisation now has centres in Colorado, Vermont, Brazil, Europe, Japan and India, including a mountain retreat centre in southern Colorado where he guides long retreats. His teaching stresses honest self-reflection, warmth of heart and the potential of everyone to wake up, and he is also an abstract painter. His books include It's Up to You, Light Comes Through, Training in Tenderness, Peaceful Heart and Diligence.

courses.title: Ngondro Retreat
courses.description: A week-long retreat at Pema Osel in Vermont and on live stream, with a full reading of Patrul Rinpoche's Words of My Perfect Teacher and the transmission of the Longchen Nyingtik ngondro. Rinpoche gives four of the teachings by live stream and his son Dungse Jampal Norbu teaches in person, with daily guided practice.

courses.title: Modern Day Bodhisattva: Awakening the Mind, Softening the Heart
courses.description: The first of Mangala Shri Bhuti's introductory online courses, based on Rinpoche's teachings. It teaches calm-abiding meditation on the breath, self-reflection and meditation on the four immeasurables, and is open to non-Buddhists. A new group starts in January 2027.

courses.title: Nyingma Summer Seminar
courses.description: A nine-day annual seminar under a large tent at Phuntsok Choling in Ward, Colorado, also live streamed, where Rinpoche and two senior teachers of his community present the whole Buddhist path through its three vehicles. Pema Chödrön is the 2027 guest; registration opens in spring 2027.
